standard_prerequisites.name: The snake lemma for a short exact sequence of complexes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the last line of the counted proof (lines 17872-17873)

core_obligations: Choose a free resolution of M and apply Hom into the given short exact sequence termwise (proof lines 17862-17864).
Because the resolution terms are free, the resulting sequence of Hom complexes is short exact (proof lines 17864-17871).
Apply the snake lemma to that short exact sequence of complexes to obtain the long exact sequence displayed in the statement (proof lines 17872-17873).
proof_roadmap: Turn the given short exact sequence into a short exact sequence of Hom complexes via a free resolution (proof lines 17861-17871).
Read the long exact sequence off the snake lemma (proof lines 17872-17874).
difficulty_reason: For an R-module M and a short exact sequence of modules, the lemma produces the long exact sequence running from Hom into the three terms through the successive Ext groups (statement lines 17839-17859). The proof does not construct the connecting maps explicitly: it takes a free resolution of M, uses freeness of the resolution terms to see that Hom into the short exact sequence is a short exact sequence of complexes, and then invokes the snake lemma to obtain the long exact sequence (proof lines 17861-17874). Identifying where exactness comes from, namely freeness of the resolution, is the content, and the author names both that step and the tool that finishes the proof. H2.
